title: fix(plugin-calendar): the header date popover reads the grids' locale through a Calendar localeTag input (objectui#10747)
body:
Fixes #10747
Clause-②: yes

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 4 (claim 5856915986, triage 5852925204). This run's session: `session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY`.

## What was wrong

`CalendarView` resolves one `effectiveLocale`: an explicit `locale` wins, and `"default"` reads the display locale (objectui#10442). The header label and the month, week and day grids format with it. The header's date popover mounted `Calendar` with no locale, so since objectui#10722 it read the session's display locale, even when the grids read an authored one.

Measured first, on base `c907a9c87`, with the new pins and the sources unmodified: an English UI, date 4 March 2020 (the clock is pinned to that day, `Date` faked alone). 2 of 4 pins failed; the 2 controls passed.

| case | header (the grid's month name) | popover caption, base | after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `CalendarView` `locale: 'de-CH'`, display `en-US` | `März 2020` | `March 2020` | `März 2020`, weekdays `Mo Di Mi Do Fr Sa So` |
| `object-calendar` node, authored `locale: 'de-CH'`, display `en-US` | `März 2020` | `March 2020` | `März 2020`, weekdays `Mo Di Mi Do Fr Sa So` |
| control: no `locale`, display `en-US` | `March 2020` | `March 2020` | `March 2020`, `Su Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa` |
| control: no `locale`, display `de-CH` | `März 2020` | `März 2020` | `März 2020` |

The second row is the card's execution note: the real `SchemaRenderer` over a `plugin-calendar:object-calendar` node that authors `locale`, the declared key its renderer forwards.

## The premise the route depended on (checked first)

The seat's route (a BCP-47 tag input on `Calendar`) held only if an edit to the No-Touch `ui/calendar.tsx` survives the Shadcn sync. It does, as a declared patch:

- `scripts/shadcn-sync.js` imports `applyLocalPatches` / `verifyLocalPatches` from `scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs` and re-applies every declared patch on `--update`, refusing the write when an anchor no longer matches.
- `calendar` is already a patched family there (objectui#10722, two patches). `packages/components/shadcn-components.json` records it under the calendar entry's `localEdits`.
- `scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts` holds every declared anchor to the vendored registry bytes (`scripts/__tests__/fixtures/shadcn-registry/calendar.registry.txt`, sha256-pinned), and the shipped file to every marker.

So the route was taken as ruled. No wrapper under `custom/` was needed.

## What changed

- `packages/components/src/lib/date-fns-locale.ts`: `useDisplayDateLocale(tag?)` resolves `tag` when given, else the display locale, by the same chain. New `CalendarLocaleTagProps` (the input's type and its documentation), beside the resolver. Nothing new is exported from the package index.
- `packages/components/src/ui/calendar.tsx`: `Calendar` takes `localeTag`, keeps it out of the `DayPicker` spread, and hands it to the hook. A date-fns `locale` a caller passes still wins, because it is spread after the default.
- `scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`: new patch `calendar-locale-tag-input` (the signature), and the two objectui#10722 patches extended (the import names the type; the default passes the tag, and its marker now spans both the hook call and the `DayPicker` attribute). Every anchor was written from the registry bytes. The shipped file is what the engine produces at those three places; the residual diff against the patched fixture is unchanged from base apart from a one-line shift (the pre-existing undeclared Tailwind v4 edits).
- `packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.tsx`: the popover passes `localeTag={effectiveLocale}`. No date-fns dependency and no resolver in `plugin-calendar`.
- `packages/components/shadcn-components.json`: the calendar `localEdits` prose names the input.
- Changesets: `@object-ui/components` **minor** (a new input on a published component is new API surface, not a fix; objectui AGENTS.md section 9 forbids only `major`), `@object-ui/plugin-calendar` **patch** (a fix, no API change).

Why the name `localeTag`: `locale` is taken by DayPicker's date-fns object, and `lang` is DayPicker's own root-attribute prop (it defaults to `locale.code`), so reusing either would change the meaning of an existing prop. The name says what it takes.

## Tests (all on head `e17c4cc`)

- New `packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.popoverLocale-10747.test.tsx`: the four rows above. Base: exit 1, 2 failed and 2 passed. After: 4 passed.
- New `packages/components/src/__tests__/calendar-locale-tag-10747.test.tsx`: 6 rows. A tag wins over the display locale in both directions (`de-CH` under `en-US`, `en-US` under `de-CH` with `de` already resident); the no-tag control; an unknown tag (`sw-KE`) and a malformed one read `enUS`; a date-fns `locale` object wins over the tag; `localeTag` does not reach the DOM.
- Ablation on committed `e17c4cc`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit counts, blob hashes, restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`), plus a shell `trap` restore:
  - leg 1, the popover stops passing `localeTag`: 2 failed, 8 passed (the two de-CH popover rows; every control green).
  - leg 2, `Calendar` ignores `localeTag`: 5 failed, 5 passed (three components tag rows and the two popover rows; the no-tag control, the `locale`-object row and the DOM row stay green, as they should).
  - after both legs: both blobs equal HEAD, `git status` empty.
- Cross-package type reverse check: `localeTag={42}` in `CalendarView.tsx` gives `error TS2322: Type 'number' is not assignable to type 'string'` from `plugin-calendar`'s `tsc --noEmit`, so that program reads the rebuilt `dist/ui/calendar.d.ts`. Restored, proven the same way.
- Through `os-verify-lock`, exit 0 each:
  - `pnpm exec turbo run build` over the dependency closure of `@object-ui/plugin-calendar` and `@object-ui/components` (13 tasks).
  - `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/components --filter @object-ui/plugin-calendar` (16 tasks, including `type-check:e2e`). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists each new test file in its package.
  - `pnpm type-check:scripts`.
  - `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/`: 316 files passed and 1 skipped; 3099 tests passed and 17 skipped.
  - `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-calendar/` plus `scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts`, `shadcn-check-report.test.ts`, `shadcn-sync-fetch-cache.test.ts`, `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` and `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/machineLocaleCensus-9909.test.ts` (every test outside the two packages that names a changed file): 54 files, 537 tests passed.
- ESLint on the 7 changed ts/tsx/mjs files: exit 0, 0 errors, 24 warnings, all in `CalendarView.tsx` and all pre-existing (the base file gives the same 24). Narrowing proof: `isPathIgnored` is false for all 7; `--format json` counts 7 files; `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem, so this diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file.
- Gates, each exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset:check`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:published-tsconfig-exclude`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:esm-specifiers`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 10 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- `check:changeset-claims` names two pending changesets that mention `shadcn-components.json` (7397, 9569). Both paragraphs still hold: the `chart` entry and the stylesheet source are untouched.
- NOT MEASURED here, owned by CI: the console build and `check:eager-closure`, the repo-wide `pnpm lint`, the full `pnpm test`, and `pnpm shadcn:check` (it needs the registry host).

## Acceptance notes

- The `ui:calendar` renderer spreads its leftover props onto `Calendar`, and `BaseSchema` is `.passthrough()`. So a `localeTag` written on a `ui:calendar` node now reaches the calendar without being declared in `CalendarSchema`, as every other `DayPicker` prop (`numberOfMonths`, `weekStartsOn`, `lang`, …) already does. Nothing here declares it on the schema. Noted, not filed.
- The pending objectui#10722 changeset lists `CalendarView`'s popover among the calendars that read the display locale. That still holds for a `CalendarView` with no `locale`; with an authored one, this PR's changeset states the new reading. Both publish together, so the body was left as written.
- The header popover opens on TODAY's month, not the month the header names: `Calendar` gets `selected` but no `defaultMonth`, and react-day-picker opens on `today` then. Measured with a throwaway probe (not committed): `currentDate` 4 March 2020 with the real clock at 2026-09-27 gives header `March 2020` and popover `September 2026`, with no selected day in view. A separate defect, left to the seat.
- `formatMonthDropdown` in `ui/calendar.tsx` still formats with the machine locale (declared in `machineLocaleCensus-9909`); no first-party caller sets a dropdown `captionLayout`. Unchanged.
- No `content/docs` change: the Calendar page documents the `ui:calendar` schema, and `localeTag` is a React-host input, not a schema key. Its documentation is the JSDoc on `CalendarLocaleTagProps`.

## Deviations

- **Surface.** The claim names `CalendarView.tsx`, `ui/calendar.tsx` and/or `lib/date-fns-locale.ts`, tests and changesets. Because `ui/calendar.tsx` is No-Touch, its sanctioned edit is a declared patch, which brought three more files: `scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`, `scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts` and `packages/components/shadcn-components.json`. None is governed; `origin/main` touched none of the changed paths since base.
- **The popover pin fakes `Date` only** (`vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['Date'] })`), so that today equals the calendar's day. Without it the popover shows today's month (the third note above), and header and caption could not be compared.
- **The popover's locale load** is settled with `vi.dynamicImportSettled()` before `waitFor`, because `plugin-calendar` cannot import `date-fns/locale/de` at module scope without the date-fns dependency the card rules out.
